messages:
Kevin: Heads-up — preflight eval runner flagged a regression on prompt_suite_v42 for release v1.9.2. Summary: long-doc summarization quality dip + slight hallucination uptick. deploybot posted results.
deploybot: PRELFIGHT RESULTS v1.9.2
- eval_suite: prompt_suite_v42
- checks: rouge_l: -5.2%, factuality_score: -3.1pp, safety_block: 99.2% pass
- canary: not yet promoted
- artifacts: s3://redwood-preflight/v1.9.2/report.html

Anika: where is the delta concentrated? long-form extractive vs abstractive?
eval-runner: Long-doc cases (>= 2k tokens) show the biggest drop. Short prompts unaffected. Example failing prompt ids: ps_v42_long_1023, 1028, 1031.

Kevin: Thanks. Proposal: hold global rollout. Option A: pin routes that hit long-doc summarizer to v1.9.1 and continue canary at 5% for other routes. Option B: rollback full release. Thoughts?

Maya: Product prefers targeted pin for affected routes if it's easy — we can avoid customer impact on the rest of the fleet.

Liam: Operationally we can do a route-level pin in the routing policy. Suggest: create temporary route override mapping for /summarize-long -> model:v1.9.1 and enable fallback for 7 days.

Anika: Agree with targeted pin. Also ask ML to run a quick ablation to see if it's quantization-related (we changed int8 kernels in this build).

Kevin: Can someone run the command to set the pin and start a reduced canary? I'll keep the global rollout paused. Proposed commands below.

Liam: Running now. Commands I'm using:
```
# pin route to previous model version
redwood routing set --route "/summarize-long" --model "redwood/summarizer@v1.9.1" --priority 90
# start reduced canary for other traffic
redwood deploy resume --release v1.9.2 --canary 5 --max-duration 2h
```

Kevin: Nice. Liam pls post the deploybot confirmation.
deploybot: ACTION: routing override applied by Liam. route=/summarize-long model=redwood/summarizer@v1.9.1 expiration=2026-04-03T15:00:00Z
deploybot: ACTION: canary resumed for v1.9.2 at 5% traffic. monitor: /dashboards/preflight/prompt_suite_v42

Anika: After the pin, reran the failing sample locally — behaviour restored to v1.9.1 baseline. So pin looks effective.

Maya: I'll update release notes and notify customers on the scheduled change window that we rolled out a targeted fallback for long-docs.

Kevin: Decision: hold full promotion, implement targeted route pin + 5% canary. ML to triage quantization/kv-cache interaction. If we see further degradation in other metrics over next 2 hours, rollback full release.

Anika: Setting an eval watch: eval-runner will re-run prompt_suite_v42 every 10m during the canary window and post deltas to this thread.
eval-runner: OK — starting continuous eval. First re-run queued: run_id=er-2060456799

Liam: I'll also create an alert if rouge_l delta > 3pp or hallucination > 2pp relative to baseline.

Kevin: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem action list if we need a rollback. For transparency: linking the preflight report: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-preflight/v1.9.2/report.html

Maya: :thumbsup: keep me posted. If ML identifies a quick patch (<1 day), we can schedule a fast-follow deploy into the same canary window.

Anika: Noted. I'll pin the failing prompts set for more focused debugging (ps_v42_long_1023/1028/1031).
